recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, chaotic collage of stylized character skulls arranged in a circular perimeter around central typography. The aesthetic combines street-art stencils with vibrant, textured gradients and heavy ink splatters on a weathered, parchment-like background.
coreVisualRelationships: Skulls act as a framing device for the central text
High-contrast dark silhouettes against a bright, textured background
Radial symmetry in character placement creates a focal vortex
Distressed textures unify disparate character designs
coreInvariants: Heavy ink splatter and spray paint textures
Stylized skull motifs with character-specific accessories
A warm, textured yellow-to-pink gradient background
Rough, distressed edges on all graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central large-scale typography surrounded by smaller, equally-weighted character icons.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, two-line title text in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular path following the skulls around the perimeter, leading inward to the central text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with splatters and icons, using the yellow background as a textured void.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm yellow and peach background with heavy texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark purple for the primary skull silhouettes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant green, red, and teal used for character details and secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the accents against a muted, grimy background value.
paletteRestrictions: Use only weathered, desaturated primary colors

letterConstructionRules: Rough, eroded edges simulating woodblock or stencil printing
Tight kerning with slight baseline shifts for a jittery feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Integration of a small skull icon into the counter of a central letter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A mix of heavy display sans for the title and smaller, cleaner sans-serifs for metadata to maintain legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed profile.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage of 10-12 stylized, character-themed skulls arranged in a circle. Use a vibrant, grungy color palette with heavy ink splatters and a weathered yellow/pink background. Leave the center open.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, two-line condensed sans-serif title in the center with a distressed, eroded texture and a dark red gradient fill.

verificationChecks: Is the texture consistent across text and icons?
Do the splatters overlap the elements naturally?
Is the central text the clear hierarchy leader?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'dirty' texture on all edges
Ensure color vibrancy is maintained despite the grunge
Verify central text legibility against the busy background
recipe.reuseFormula: Circular framing + Distressed Typography + Urban Splatter Texture
